name: CKEditor Templates
project_description:
This module integrates the Ckeditor templates plugin .

 It provides a dialog to offer predefined content templates - with page layout, text formatting and styles. Thus, end users can easily insert pre-defined snippets of html in CKEditor fields.

 Drupal 10 
 This recently added support for CKeditor 5. Please create an issue if any problems or possible improvements are found.

 Audience 
 This module is intended for themers who can manage custom ckeditor templates from their theme. As is, it doesn't provide any fonctionnality.

 Dependencies 
 This module requires the Ckeditor templates plugin .

How to add it :

 
 Download the plugin on the project page : http://ckeditor.com/addon/templates 
 Create a libraries folder in your drupal root if it doesn't exist 
 Extract the plugin archive in the librairies folder 
 
 Related modules 
 
 CkEditor Template UI : adds a user interface to edit templates from the backoffice
